# Room Readings: Messaging & Positioning Package **Status:** Draft for review **Voice Profile:** Concise, exact, professional **Primary Audience:** Greenhouse facility managers (operational consolidation) & finance reviewers (record substantiation) **Evidence Baseline:** Fictional supplied brief; all unlisted integrations, certifications, SLAs, and performance claims remain unverified unknowns. --- ## 1. Homepage Opening ### Headline **Consolidate greenhouse meter readings across rooms and dates.** ### Supporting Line Upload CSV meter files to review daily consumption by room, replace fragmented spreadsheets, and export dated summaries of submitted readings. --- ## 2. Proof Caption *Asset: Interactive sample dataset and export report walkthrough.* > **Walkthrough Dataset Preview** > Illustrates room-by-room aggregation and exported report layouts using standardized sample CSV inputs. Demonstrates file structure and export formatting; does not represent automated telemetry, certified compliance records, or measured utility savings. --- ## 3. Main-Action Expectations & Setup Path ### Call to Action **Request a sample-data walkthrough** ### Action Expectations Submitting a request schedules a demonstration of the room-by-room view using sample CSV records. Scheduling turnaround and walkthrough format are confirmed following submission. A walkthrough demonstrates interface capabilities and report formats; it does not initiate production deployment. ### Production Setup Path Production onboarding requires operational alignment before data processing begins: 1. **Format Alignment:** Review and agree upon expected CSV column schemas and unit definitions. 2. **Workflow Definition:** Confirm operational roles—specifically who exports, verifies, and submits meter files for each room. 3. **Data Import & Review:** Begin manual CSV uploads to generate consolidated daily views and export dated summary records. *Operational Note:* Software capabilities are strictly bounded by submitted CSV data. Automated sensor integrations, cryptographic immutability, specific data-retention windows, and guaranteed support response deadlines are unconfirmed specifications. --- ## 4. Finance-Reviewer Pitch > "Room Readings centralizes disparate facility spreadsheets into a single, dated record of submitted meter entries. For finance reviewers, the system provides an exportable audit trail showing exactly which CSV meter readings were uploaded for each room by date. > > The software substantiates submitted operational records rather than independent physical measurements: it does not perform automated carbon accounting, apply cryptographic signatures, or provide third-party validation. It replaces uncoordinated email attachments and local spreadsheets with a consistent, dated consolidation of reported utility inputs." --- ## 5. Compressed Brand Card | Attribute | Specification | | :--- | :--- | | **Brand** | Room Readings | | **Category** | Greenhouse Utility Meter Consolidation Software | | **Primary Audience** | Facility managers seeking single-dashboard visibility; finance reviewers requiring structured reporting. | | **Core Mechanism** | Manual CSV upload $\rightarrow$ Daily room-level aggregation $\rightarrow$ Dated summary export. | | **Current Alternative** | Local spreadsheets exchanged via monthly email threads. | | **Established Scope** | Browser-based consolidation of manually uploaded CSV meter data. | | **Explicit Exclusions / Unknowns** | No confirmed live IoT/sensor feeds, carbon credit verification, automated billing adjustments, cryptographic immutability, or third-party audit certifications. | | **Voice & Tone** | Concise, exact, professional. Transparent about operational boundaries. | | **Primary Conversion** | Request a sample-data walkthrough (scheduling terms confirmed post-inquiry). | --- ## 6. Before / After Revision Record | Field | Content | | :--- | :--- | | **Original Passage** | *"Independently certified, immutable carbon proof. Cut bills by 30% instantly."* | | **Defect Diagnosis** | **Factual Overstatement & Unsupported Value Claims:**
1. Claims "independent certification" without testing or registry affiliation.
2. Promises "immutable proof" when the platform ingests standard user-supplied CSV files without digital signatures.
3. Introduces unverified "carbon" domain accounting.
4. Guarantees a speculative, unmeasured commercial outcome ("Cut bills by 30% instantly"). | | **Replacement Passage** | **"Upload CSV meter readings to view daily consumption by room and export dated summaries of submitted records."** | | **Input-Based Rationale** | Aligns strictly with demonstrated software functionality: CSV file upload, room/day dashboard organization, and dated export creation. Leaves utility bill reductions, certifications, and emissions claims unstated until substantiated by verified customer evidence. |
